decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Drawings E00, E01, E02, E03, E04, E05, P00, P01, P02, P03, P04, P05, P06, P08, and SuDS proforma. Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved, the existing outbuilding in the rear garden, as identified on drawing E00 Location Plan and Block Plan shall be demolished and all resultant materials removed from the site. The area shall thereafter be laid out and retained as private amenity space in accordance with the approved plans.Reason:To ensure the provision of adequate private amenity space and cycle storage access in accordance with Policy D6, D3 and D4 London Plan 2021, Core Strategy CP30 and Policy DMD8 and  DMD9 of the Development Management Document.

Notwithstanding the details shown on the submitted drawings, the development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until details of the 6 long-stay cycle parking spaces and the rear access have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  These details should demonstrate: Location :Near entrances or main access  Design: Stands or wall bars  Security: Secure, overlooked, well-lit  Coverage: Covered where possible  Accessibility: Step-free, no obstructions   The cycle parking spaces shall be fully constructed in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation and shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development.   Reason: To ensure that adequate cycle parking facilities are provided to promote sustainable modes of transport.

Notwithstanding the details shown on the submitted drawings, prior to the first occupation of the HMO hereby permitted, waste storage and recycling facilities to satisfy the permitted number of occupiers shall have been provided on site, in accordance with the Enfield's Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024). Such facilities are to be retained thereafter, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that adequate waste and recycling storage facilities are provided to meet the needs of future occupiers, promote sustainable waste management practices, and support borough-wide recycling targets.

Notwithstanding the details shown on the submitted drawings, the development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until details of an additional rooflight in the existing flat roof to serve the communal kitchen/dining area have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The rooflight shall be fully constructed in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation and shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To ensure adquate levels of natural light and satisfactory residential amenity for the future occupiers in accordance with London Plan Policy D6, Development Management Document policies DMD8 and DMD37 and the National Planning Policy Framework.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture as specified in the approved application. Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

No cooking facilities, including hot plates, shall be installed in the bedrooms of the development hereby permitted unless details have first been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Any cooking facilities shall thereafter only be implemented in accordance with the details that have been approved pursuant to this condition.Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied by more than six residents at any one time without first obtaining the approval, in writing, of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that the future occupation of the building does not adversely affect the adjoining premises/immediate
